generalCriterionList.description: Valid contractor Registration Certificate issued from competent authority in appropriate contractor class

Financial Turnover Certificate obtained and certified by the Registered Valid Chartered Accountant indicating the Registration no of Chartered Accountant with UDIN number details along with profit and loss statement tallying the annual Turnover

Work done certificate for the work performed as prime contractor (in the same name) on works of Similar Nature over during the five years specified (Similar Nature of work done certificate i.e, 50% of amount put to tender)
Unconditional Line of credit i.e, 30% of amount put to tender obtained from Nationalised/Scheduled Banks in Given Pro-forma in the bid document
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Valid PAN Card and Valid GST Registration certificates and Valid Labour contractor License
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

itemList.description: KSRB 2-2.1 : Earthwork excavation by manual means for foundation of buildings, culverts, water supply and sanitary lines and electrical conduits etc, either in pits or in trenches 1.5m and above in width, in ordinary soil not exceeding 1.5 m. in depth including dressing the bottom and sides of pits and trenches, stacking the excavated soil clear from edges of excavation with lead upto 50 m. including breaking of clods complete as per specifications. No. KBS 2.1(a) / 2.3.5

Providing Course sand bedding for pipelines trenches including watering and consolidation by punners etc. Complete with all lead and lift (in black cotton soil and rock reaches) (Black Sand) (Water Board Approved Rate)

Providing and laying reinforced cement concrete pipe NP3 for culverts including pointing ends, and fixing collars with cement mortar 1:2 including cost of all materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications. Specifications. No. KSRB 1000, 2300 MOST Specification No.1000 / 2300 300mm. dia

KSRB 2-4 : Refilling available earth around pipe lines, cables in layers not exceeding 20cms in depth, compacting each deposited layer by ramming after watering with lead upto 50m. and lift upto 1.5 m. including cost of all labour complete as per specifications

KSRRB M400-17. Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stones aggregate to wet mix macadam specifications including pre mixing the material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed method of tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver in sub-base/base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density complete as per specifications. MORTH Specification No. 406

Construction of Circular Type BBM UGD Manhole Chamber of 1200mm dia at bottom, with Conical Shape at top Excavation in all types of soils & surface, removing and disposal of the excavated stuff, levelled and neatly dressed. Providing & laying Bed Concrete of 250mm thick PCC of mix 1.3:6 with 40mm and downsize graded coarse aggregate. Providing and constructing burnt brick masonry with 150mm offset for UGD Manhole with approved quality of non-modular bricks of standard size & class designation 3.5 N/sqmm in CM '1:6. Providing & fixing Cast lron Foot Rests in BBM with PCC 1 .2:4 at 300 mm staggered intervals. Providing 12mm thick cement plaster in single coat with CM 1:4, to the internal & external surfaces of BBM with rounding off corners & smooth rendering along with refilling of available excavated earth around the BBM on the outside in layers not exceeding 20cms in depth, compacting each deposited layer by ramming after watering. Providing and fixing S.F.R.C Cover and Frame 560mm (lD) Heavy Dutyfirmly in position with 150 mm thick PCC of mix1.2.4 with 20mm and down size graded coarse aggregates concrete laid in layers & well compacted.Providing Brick relieving whenever pipe is to be connected with manhole with PCC of mix 1:2:4 finishing with a neat float of cement slurry at the bottom complete in all respects, barricading, danger lighting, watering, bailing out water, removal of slush, pouring tar over manhole cover and all other incidental works including cost of all materials, scaffolding, labour, HOM of machinery, curing complete as per specifications and directions of the engineer MHC 1.20m Deep
